recommendation_bar.note: Pilot threshold below which a role is not shown as a feasible adjacent role. A configured cut-off, not a probability.

limitations: Role requirements are team-drafted hypotheses, not yet reviewed by a human domain expert or validated against live Delhi-NCR listings.
Demand and vacancy data are simulated samples. No live vacancy feed is connected and no demand claim is made.
No NCO, ESCO or O*NET identifiers have been mapped yet.
Scores are estimated skill fit, not hiring probability.
